summary: Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO today after 15 years at the helm. John Ternus will assume the role tomorrow, just ahead of the highly anticipated September 9 event.
details: Today marks the end of an era at Apple as Tim Cook officially steps down from his position as CEO. Cook led the tech giant for 15 years, overseeing a period of immense growth and diversification for the company.
Effective tomorrow, John Ternus will take over as the new CEO. Ternus's appointment comes just before Apple's significant September 9 event, where new products and announcements are expected.
caption:
A major leadership change at Apple: Tim Cook steps down after 15 years as CEO.

Today marks the end of an era at Apple as Tim Cook officially steps down from his position as CEO. Cook led the tech giant for 15 years, overseeing a period of immense growth and diversification for the company.

Effective tomorrow, John Ternus will take over as the new CEO. Ternus's appointment comes just before Apple's significant September 9 event, where new products and announcements are expected.
